To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have computed two-loop radiative correction to the quark and gluon form factor to all orders in epsilon = d - 4, which is an important ingredient in models with large-extra dimensions.
we have calculated the complete two-loop corrections to the gravitons form factors and found that they obey the same evolution equations as the vector and gluon form factor.
we have computed the two-loop corrections to the gravitons-quark-antquark and graviton-glugluon form factors in the context of large extra-dimentional theories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the calculation of the two-loop corrections to the form factors in QCD.
the calculation of the graviton form factors in SU(N) QCD to two-loops.
the development and application of the theory of the quantum theory of fields and particles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the graviton-quarks and gluons are just like the electroweak and QCD gauge bosons
these form factors are identical to the ones for the electroweak gauge boson form factors, and the same is true for the graviton-gluino and graviton-squark form factors.
the two-loop corrections to the form factor G∗i → g g are completely determined by the corresponding form factors of the electroweak boson G∗i → VV and gluon G∗i→ gg.
